description:
Staff Software Engineer at Ludbrook Systems

Ludbrook Systems is a small infrastructure company building billing platforms for hardware vendors. We're hiring a Staff Engineer to own the payments and metering subsystems end-to-end.

What you'll do
- Design and ship the service that meters usage across our customer fleets — tens of thousands of events per second, with strict ordering guarantees.
- Be the technical anchor on a team of 4 engineers. Own the architecture decisions; set code-review norms.
- Partner with finance and compliance on invoicing logic; sit in on customer audits when needed.
- Lead incident response when metering or billing breaks. Own post-mortems end-to-end.

What we're looking for
- 8+ years of backend experience; 3+ at staff/senior-staff level.
- Deep systems knowledge: event-driven architectures, exactly-once semantics, idempotent APIs.
- Strong TypeScript or Go. Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis.
- Comfortable operating production systems — on-call rotation, observability, capacity planning.
- Written communication is a requirement — we ship a lot of RFCs.

Nice to have
- Background in payments, billing, or financial infrastructure.
- Experience leading post-mortems at scale.
